semiconductor_relevance: Medium — Shanchuang Industrial provides fluid system components and sensor solutions that are critical for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Shanchuang Industrial (Shanghai) Co., Ltd. specializes in providing a comprehensive range of fluid system components, including sensors, valves, and connectors, essential for semiconductor plant construction and high-purity gas systems. Established in 2014, the company focuses on supporting the intelligent manufacturing upgrade of high-end industries in China.
capabilities: Pressure gauges and transmitters for ultra-high purity applications
Gas mass flow meters and controllers

regional_presence.China: The company is focused on serving the semiconductor industry within China, leveraging local manufacturing capabilities.
